description: This file contains a static internal class 'JournalingAzureStorageTestConfiguration' which provides configuration and precondition checks for Azure Storage tests related to the Orleans project. It includes methods to validate environment settings and configure default options for Azure Append Blob State Machine Storage.

classes.name: JournalingAzureStorageTestConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing methods to check test preconditions and configure Azure storage options for testing purposes.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if the necessary environment variables or configurations are set to run tests, and skips tests if preconditions are not met.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults
methods.description: An extension method on AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions to set default options based on the configuration environment.
